Load data

# Standard data
df <- readRDS("./data/dataset/df.RDS")
tr <- read.tree("./data/tree/tree.treefile") 

## KPC Plasmids 
KPC_info_clusters <- readRDS("./data/KPC_plasmid/KPC_containing_clusters_mat.RDS") %>% as.data.frame 
KPC_containing_clusters <- KPC_info_clusters %>% `colnames<-`(paste0(colnames(.),"_KPC")) %>% {ifelse(.=="KPC Plasmid",1,0)} %>% as.data.frame%>% select_if(colSums(.)>0)
cluster_KPC_containing_clusters <- Heatmap(KPC_containing_clusters)
plasmid_order <- colnames(KPC_containing_clusters[column_order(cluster_KPC_containing_clusters)])

KPC_clusters <- colnames(KPC_containing_clusters) 
df <- left_join(df,KPC_containing_clusters %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.)))  

## BLBLI clustering
pclustering <- readRDS("./data/asr_clustering/blbli_asr_clustering_df.RDS")
blbli_asr <- readRDS("./data/asr_clustering/blbli_asr.RDS")
df <- left_join(df,KPC_containing_clusters %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.)))  
df <- left_join(df,pclustering %>% select(isolate_no,blbli_asr_cluster_renamed))
df$blbli_asr_cluster_renamed_simple <- recode(df$blbli_asr_cluster_renamed,"No Feature"="Susceptible" )

# KPC_copy number
KPC_copy_number <- readRDS("./data/KPC_coverage/normalized/KPNIH1_KPC_plasmid_depth_by_feature_median_chromosome_normalized.RDS") %>% select(KPNIH1_RS28775_chr_median_norm) %>% rename(KPC_copy_number=KPNIH1_RS28775_chr_median_norm) %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.))

df <- left_join(df,KPC_copy_number)

df$KPC_plasmid <- sapply(df$isolate_no,FUN=function(x){
  plasmid <- KPC_containing_clusters %>% subset(rownames(.)==x) %>% colSums(.) %>% subset(.>0)%>% names()
  ifelse(length(plasmid)==0,"No Plasmid",plasmid)
}) %>% unlist

# KPC plasmid copy number
KPC_plasmid_copy_number <- readRDS("./data/KPC_plasmid_coverage/KPC_plasmid_copy_number_chromosome_normalized.RDS")
df <- left_join(df,KPC_plasmid_copy_number)

# KPC gene
KPC_data <- read.table("./data/KPC_blast/KPC_blast_master.txt",header = T)  
KPC_data$KPC_allele <- paste0("bla",str_split(KPC_data$sseqid,"\\|",simplify = T) %>% .[,ncol(.)])
df <- left_join(df,KPC_data %>% select(isolate_no,KPC_allele))
df$KPC_allele <- ifelse(is.na(df$KPC_allele),"No blaKPC",df$KPC_allele)

Plot on the tree

df$KPC_copy_number_log2 <- log2(df$KPC_copy_number)
df$KPC_plasmid_copy_number_log2 <- log2(df$KPC_plasmid_median_copy_chromosome_normalized)

rownames(df) <- df$isolate_no

p0 <- gheatmap(ggtree(tr),data=df %>% select(blbli_asr_cluster_renamed) %>% mutate_all(as.factor) %>% `colnames<-`("BL/BLI clustering"), colnames_position = "top",colnames_angle=90, colnames_offset_y = 0.25, hjust = 0, color = NA, font.size = 4, width = 0.05) + cluster_scale_1_order_2_col  + ylim(NA,550) + consistent_theme_s_figure_6_wo_md

p0.1 <- p0+ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()

p1 <- gheatmap(p0.1,data=df %>% select(blbli_dich) %>% mutate_all(as.factor) %>% `colnames<-`(c("BL/BLI resistance")), colnames_position = "top",colnames_angle=90, colnames_offset_y = 0.25, hjust = 0, color = NA, font.size = 4, width = 0.05,offset=.0000125) + resistance_scale_order_2 + ylim(NA,550) + consistent_theme_s_figure_6_wo_md

p1.1 <- p1+ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()

p2 <- gheatmap(p1.1,data=df %>% select(MVB_log_2,IR_log_2) %>% mutate_all(as.factor) %>% `colnames<-`(c("Meropenem-vaborbactam MIC","Imipenem-relebactam MIC")), colnames_position = "top",colnames_angle=90, colnames_offset_y = 0.25, hjust = 0, color = NA, font.size = 4, width = 0.1,offset=.000025) + Log2_scale_3_order + ylim(NA,550) + consistent_theme_s_figure_6_wo_md
  
p2.1 <- p2+ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()

p3 <- gheatmap(p2.1,data=df %>% select(KPC_allele) %>% `colnames<-`(c("blaKPC allele")), colnames_position = "top",colnames_angle=90, colnames_offset_y = 0.25, hjust = 0, color = NA, font.size = 4, width = 0.05,offset=.00005) + kpc_scale + consistent_theme_s_figure_6_wo_md   + guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
        title.position = "top",
        label.position = "right",
        order=4,
        ncol = 1,theme = theme(legend.title=element_markdown(),legend.text=element_markdown())
    )
)

p3.1 <- p3+ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()

p4 <- gheatmap(p3.1,data=df %>% select(KPC_plasmid_copy_number_log2,KPC_copy_number_log2) %>% `colnames<-`(c("log2 blaKPC plasmid copy number","log2 blaKPC gene copy number")), colnames_position = "top",colnames_angle=90, colnames_offset_y = 0.25, hjust = 0, color = NA, font.size = 4, width = 0.1,offset=.00006125)    +consistent_theme_s_figure_6_wo_md   + log2_cont_scale + ylim(NA,550)  

p4.1 <- p4 + ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()
  
figure <- gheatmap(p4.1,data=KPC_containing_clusters[,plasmid_order] %>% mutate_all(as.factor) %>% `colnames<-`(paste0(colnames(.) %>% gsub("_KPC","",.)," blaKPC-containing plasmid")), colnames_position = "top",colnames_angle=90, colnames_offset_y = 0.25, hjust = 0, color = NA, font.size = 4, width = 0.5,offset =.0000875) + plasmid_scale_v + ylim(NA,590)   + consistent_theme_s_figure_6_wo_md  

figure

Save the figure

ggsave("./figures/s_figure_6_KPC_copy_number_across_phylogeny.png",plot = figure, units = 'in', height = 9.333, width = 10.5, dpi = 900, bg='white')
